en.title: [BK21 Graduate School Innovation Team] International Students’ Guide to Participating in Psychological Health Examination
summary: This is a guide for international students to participate in the Psychological Health Examination hosted by the BK21 Graduate School Innovation Team (대학원혁신단).
The application period is from September 28 (Mon) to October 16 (Fri), 2026.
The inspection (examination) period will run from October 19 (Mon) to November 6 (Fri), 2026.
Follow-up visits will take place from November 9 (Mon), 2026, to January 13 (Wed), 2027, with details provided individually.
For other inquiries, please contact the Graduate School Innovation Team via email (wldn05180@inha.ac.kr).
en.easyExplanation: This is a psychological health examination program for international students. Interested international students must apply by October 16 (Fri), and the examination will begin on October 19 (Mon).
